name: Weather
text: Open‑Meteo forecast, no API key. Temperature, precipitation, wind.

name: Crypto ticker
text: Up to 10 coins in rotation, 24h change in color.

name: CI status
text: GitHub Actions and GitLab CI. Blinks when a build fails.

name: Calendar
text: Any iCal link. Reminds you 5 minutes before a meeting.

name: Pomodoro
text: 25/5 cycles started from the clock’s button, with daily stats.

name: Now playing
text: Track and equalizer from your Mac over USB.

name: Home Assistant
text: Any sensor or event, with color changes at thresholds.

name: macOS notifications
text: Forward notifications from the apps you choose.

name: World clock
text: Up to four time zones, cycling with city codes.

name: Stock watchlist
text: Your tickers with daily change and a sparkline row.

name: Uptime monitor
text: Pings your endpoints and turns red when one goes down.

name: Air quality
text: AQI and PM2.5 for your area, color‑coded.
